# DMK Youth Wing (திமுக இளைஞரணி)

> Official community website of the DMK Youth Wing, Tamil Nadu. Join the movement, follow member activities, listen to the podcast and explore recommended reading.

## Main sections
- [Home](https://dmkyw.in/): Mission, voices, works on the ground and news
- [Join the Youth Wing](https://dmkyw.in/#join): Membership form
- [YW Feeds](https://dmkyw.in/#yw/feeds): Activities by members across Tamil Nadu
- [Podcast](https://dmkyw.in/#yw/podcast): Episodes and speeches
- [Bookshelf](https://dmkyw.in/#yw/books): Books that shaped the Dravidian movement
- [Leaderboard](https://dmkyw.in/#yw/leaderboard): Most active members
- [Ideas](https://dmkyw.in/#yw/ideas): Submit and vote on ideas
